treatment_protocol_ch1: Eight-week-old control or LSD1-mKO mice were single-housed in cages with free access to a vertical running wheel (Shinano Seisakusho) for 38 days. After three days of familiarization,  LSD1-KO was induced by  tamoxifen injection at a dose of 75 mg/kg for five consecutive days, and running distance was measured during the next 30 days.

flags.note: the stop reason says no exercise arm, yet these values carry exercise words

stop_claims.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all 6 sequenced soleus samples are VWR-trained (GEO treatment constant 'VWR training'); no sedentary RNA-seq arm was deposited. The only contrast is genotype (LSD1-mKO vs WT) within exercised mice, which does not estimate how exercise affects gene expression, and the exercise x genotype interaction is not estimable.
